column2: 耶穌上了船，渡過海，來到自己的城裡。
column3: Getting into a boat, Jesus crossed over [the sea] and came to His own city.

column2: 有人用褥子抬著一個癱子到耶穌跟前來。耶穌見他們的信心，就對癱子說：小子，放心罷！你的罪赦了。
column3: And they brought to Him a paralytic lying on a bed. Seeing their faith, Jesus said to the paralytic, 'Take courage, son; your sins are forgiven.'

column2: 有幾個文士心裡說：這個人說僭妄的話了。
column3: And some of the scribes said to themselves, 'This [fellow] blasphemes.'

column2: 耶穌知道他們的心意，就說：你們為甚麼心裡懷著惡念呢？
column3: And Jesus knowing their thoughts said, 'Why are you thinking evil in your hearts?

column2: 或說：你的罪赦了，或說：你起來行走，那一樣容易呢？
column3: 'Which is easier, to say, 'Your sins are forgiven,' or to say, 'Get up, and walk '?

column2: 但要叫你們知道，人子在地上有赦罪的權柄；就對癱子說：起來！拿你的褥子回家去罷。
column3: 'But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins '-- then He said to the paralytic, 'Get up, pick up your bed and go home.'

column2: 那人就起來，回家去了。
column3: And he got up and went home.

column2: 眾人看見都驚奇，就歸榮耀與神，因為他將這樣的權柄賜給人。
column3: But when the crowds saw [this], they were awestruck, and glorified God, who had given such authority to men.

column2: 耶穌從那裡往前走，看見一個人名叫馬太，坐在稅關上，就對他說：你跟從我來。他就起來跟從了耶穌。
column3: As Jesus went on from there, He saw a man called Matthew, sitting in the tax collector's booth; and He said to him, 'Follow Me!' And he got up and followed Him.

column2: 耶穌在屋裡坐席的時候，有好些稅吏和罪人來，與耶穌和他的門徒一同坐席。
column3: Then it happened that as Jesus was reclining [at the table] in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and were dining with Jesus and His disciples.

column2: 法利賽人看見，就對耶穌的門徒說：你們的先生為甚麼和稅吏並罪人一同吃飯呢？
column3: When the Pharisees saw [this], they said to His disciples, 'Why is your Teacher eating with the tax collectors and sinners?'

column2: 耶穌聽見，就說：康健的人用不著醫生，有病的人才用得著。
column3: But when Jesus heard [this], He said, '[It is] not those who are healthy who need a physician, but those who are sick.

column2: 經上說：我喜愛憐恤，不喜愛祭祀。這句話的意思，你們且去揣摩。我來本不是召義人，乃是召罪人。
column3: 'But go and learn what this means: 'I DESIRE COMPASSION, AND NOT SACRIFICE,' for I did not come to call the righteous, but sinners.'

column2: 那時，約翰的門徒來見耶穌，說：我們和法利賽人常常禁食，你的門徒倒不禁食，這是為甚麼呢？
column3: Then the disciples of John came to Him, asking, 'Why do we and the Pharisees fast, but Your disciples do not fast?'

column2: 耶穌對他們說：新郎和陪伴之人同在的時候，陪伴之人豈能哀慟呢？但日子將到，新郎要離開他們，那時候他們就要禁食。
column3: And Jesus said to them, 'The attendants of the bridegroom cannot mourn as long as the bridegroom is with them, can they? But the days will come when the bridegroom is taken away from them, and then they will fast.

column2: 沒有人把新布補在舊衣服上；因為所補上的反帶壞了那衣服，破的就更大了。
column3: 'But no one puts a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; for the patch pulls away from the garment, and a worse tear results.

column2: 也沒有人把新酒裝在舊皮袋裡；若是這樣，皮袋就裂開，酒漏出來，連皮袋也壞了。惟獨把新酒裝在新皮袋裡，兩樣就都保全了。
column3: 'Nor do [people] put new wine into old wineskins; otherwise the wineskins burst, and the wine pours out and the wineskins are ruined; but they put new wine into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.'

column2: 耶穌說這話的時候，有一個管會堂的來拜他，說：我女兒剛才死了，求你去按手在他身上，他就必活了。
column3: While He was saying these things to them, a [synagogue] official came and bowed down before Him, and said, 'My daughter has just died; but come and lay Your hand on her, and she will live.'

column2: 耶穌便起來跟著他去；門徒也跟了去。
column3: Jesus got up and [began] to follow him, and [so did] His disciples.

column2: 有一個女人，患了十二年的血漏，來到耶穌背後，摸他的衣裳繸子；
column3: And a woman who had been suffering from a hemorrhage for twelve years, came up behind Him and touched the fringe of His cloak;

column2: 因為他心裡說：我只摸他的衣裳，就必痊愈。
column3: for she was saying to herself, 'If I only touch His garment, I will get well.'

column2: 耶穌轉過來，看見他，就說：女兒，放心！你的信救了你。從那時候，女人就痊愈了。
column3: But Jesus turning and seeing her said, 'Daughter, take courage; your faith has made you well.'

column2: 耶穌到了管會堂的家裡，看見有吹手，又有許多人亂嚷，
column3: When Jesus came into the official's house, and saw the flute-players and the crowd in noisy disorder,

column2: 就說：退去罷！這閨女不是死了，是睡著了。他們就嗤笑他。
column3: He said, 'Leave; for the girl has not died, but is asleep.' And they [began] laughing at Him.

column2: 眾人既被攆出，耶穌就進去，拉著閨女的手，閨女便起來了。
column3: But when the crowd had been sent out, He entered and took her by the hand, and the girl got up.

column2: 於是這風聲傳遍了那地方。
column3: This news spread throughout all that land.

column2: 耶穌從那裡往前走，有兩個瞎子跟著他，喊叫說：大衛的子孫，可憐我們罷！
column3: As Jesus went on from there, two blind men followed Him, crying out, 'Have mercy on us, Son of David!'

column2: 耶穌進了房子，瞎子就來到他跟前。耶穌說：你們信我能作這事麼？他們說：主阿，我們信。
column3: When He entered the house, the blind men came up to Him, and Jesus said to them, 'Do you believe that I am able to do this?' They said to Him, 'Yes, Lord.'

column2: 耶穌就摸他們的眼睛，說：照著你們的信給你們成全了罷。
column3: Then He touched their eyes, saying, 'It shall be done to you according to your faith.'

column2: 他們的眼睛就開了。耶穌切切的囑咐他們說：你們要小心，不可叫人知道。
column3: And their eyes were opened. And Jesus sternly warned them: 'See that no one knows [about this]!'

column2: 他們出去，竟把他的名聲傳遍了那地方。
column3: But they went out and spread the news about Him throughout all that land.

column2: 他們出去的時候，有人將鬼所附的一個啞吧帶到耶穌跟前來。
column3: As they were going out, a mute, demon-possessed man was brought to Him.

column2: 鬼被趕出去，啞吧就說出話來。眾人都希奇，說：在以色列中，從來沒有見過這樣的事。
column3: After the demon was cast out, the mute man spoke; and the crowds were amazed, [and were] saying, 'Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel.'

column2: 法利賽人卻說：他是靠著鬼王趕鬼。
column3: But the Pharisees were saying, 'He casts out the demons by the ruler of the demons.'

column2: 耶穌走遍各城各鄉，在會堂裡教訓人，宣講天國的福音，又醫治各樣的病症。
column3: Jesus was going through all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues and proclaiming the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every kind of disease and every kind of sickness.

column2: 他看見許多的人，就憐憫他們；因為他們困苦流離，如同羊沒有牧人一般。
column3: Seeing the people, He felt compassion for them, because they were distressed and dispirited like sheep without a shepherd.

column2: 於是對門徒說：要收的莊稼多，作工的人少。
column3: Then He said to His disciples, 'The harvest is plentiful, but the workers are few.

column2: 所以，你們當求莊稼的主打發工人出去收他的莊稼。
column3: 'Therefore beseech the Lord of the harvest to send out workers into His harvest.'
